race.comment: LIYAH'S GIRL (4) brings consistent form, coming off a close third at Gosford and performing well around 2000m. She's placed four times in five starts at this track and distance, drawing barrier 1, making her the most reliable despite her infrequent wins. No excuses today. MISSION STRIKE (5) poses the biggest threat with two recent seconds, the latest at Scone after being bumped early. He also beat LIYAH'S GIRL at Gosford and the first-time visors will help. Expected to go close fourth up. DON'T BACK DOWN (8) ran well at Goulburn going under narrowly when she dictated the early speed. Shapes as a credible place chance at this distance if the six-day turnaround doesn't affect her. Blinkers come off and can handle the sting out of the ground. SOLAR ORBIT (6) comes off a plain sixth at Gundagai, but his previous third on soft ground here keeps him in the mix with Cahill's claim.
